authorization: User authorized versioned ETF action/source repair and impact audit of existing results, not a new strategy.
question: Which existing event/control endpoint and full-path results actually change when verified corporate actions are added under their ORIGINAL exclusion rules? Separate source completeness, eligibility reasons and numerical impact.
source_protocol: Resolve proposed, cancelled and executed actions from issuer/exchange documents. A proposal is not an executed adjustment. Version the source ledger before running impact counts. Adding one verified action does not prove all-window completeness. No original action/price bytes or boolean declarations are overwritten; a superseding machine-readable overlay records their current qualification.

impact_protocol.endpoint: For both original legs and every h, inspect exact saved timestamps and compare original versus updated action crossing (entry_day < effective_day <= exit_day). Also record halted-day endpoints and unit-bridge crossings to first resumed trading date. No clock shift or imputation.
impact_protocol.full_path: Retain original 240-index-bar common path rule and annual/pair gates. Count all frozen pairs including blocked carriers. Do not open previously blocked carrier outcomes.
impact_protocol.returns: If included sample membership changes, apply only original rules and recompute affected published groups in a NEW directory; otherwise reconcile existing ledger identities and state no numerical rewrite needed. No adjusted-price factor fitting, account PnL, or new return sample.
impact_protocol.lookbacks: Inventory repository code references to the ETF package and trace whether price features or lookbacks consume ETF prices. Distinguish verified consumers, transitive report/test replays and unresolved dynamic consumers.
impact_protocol.intraday: Replay same-day, same-session 60s measurability under the verified action list and audit changes; this is not a reversion outcome.
impact_protocol.semantics: Inspect pinned source flags, exporter code and available upstream dictionaries. Unknown exchange-time, zero-volume, fill and availability semantics stay UNKNOWN. No guessed repair.

prohibitions: no outcomes for failed strict-control pairs
stop: Deliver versioned source action overlay, source-provenance resolution matrix, complete original-window impact ledger, consumer inventory, necessary changed-result receipts and tests. Do not append a replacement strategy.
source_guard: Every baseline tracked input read is verified against git ls-tree at baseline_commit; delivered raw file SHA256/bytes/rows are checked against the unchanged manifests.
